description: 2nd connection - URGENT PRIORITY: restore &LIB/JUCSRV, which the 1st connection left MISSING. The 1st connection's git/clone mechanics (SETUP/BARE/PCREPO/PUSH/CLONE/ROUNDTRIP-EDIT/ROUNDTRIP-PULL) all CONFIRMED SUCCESS - unchanged here. But CRTRPGMOD ... SRCSTMF(...) failed both times with RNS9380 'The source file CCSID 1208 is a Unicode CCSID which cannot be used with TGTCCSID(*SRC)' - `git clone` checks out files tagged CCSID 1208 (confirmed via `ls -S`, batch.mjs's own documented convention: CCSID is `ls -S`'s first column), and CRTRPGMOD's default TGTCCSID(*SRC) explicitly refuses ANY Unicode-tagged source file (cl_commands_75.txt's own TGTCCSID doc: '*SRC: the source is read in the CCSID of the primary source file... 1-65534: the CCSID must be a single-byte or mixed-byte EBCDIC CCSID' - 1208 is neither *SRC-compatible nor a listed EBCDIC value). FIXED here by adding TGTCCSID(*JOB) to both CRTRPGMOD calls (SRCSTMF steps only - CRTSRVPGM's own binder-source SRCSTMF parameter has no documented TGTCCSID equivalent in cl_commands_75.txt, so BUILDSRV is unchanged and this connection is this parameter's first real test). WORSE: because DLTMOD (this manifest's own stale-object guard) ran first and then BUILDMOD failed, and BUILDSRV's CRTSRVPGM REPLACE(*YES) apparently deletes the OLD service program object even when its own MODULE lookup then fails (CPF5D02) and it aborts without creating a replacement - the 1st connection left &LIB/JUCSRV (the *SRVPGM) genuinely MISSING (CLIENTCHECK: CPD0192 'Service program JUCSRV not found' for both F0702A and F0703A). This is a real, repo-wide-impact regression (TSTJUCSRV/08-04, and Part 9's planned 09-04, both depend on this exact object) that this connection's own first priority is to repair, by successfully completing BUILDMOD+BUILDSRV with the TGTCCSID fix. Steps are reordered so the repair (DLTMOD/BUILDMOD/BUILDSRV/CLIENTCHECK) runs BEFORE the round-trip rehearsal and makei probes, in case anything else goes wrong mid-connection. Also fixed: makei --version/--help/build --help ALL failed in the 1st connection, even via full path, because makei is a wrapper script that checks its OWN directory is on PATH regardless of how it was invoked, and additionally requires python3.9 specifically to be resolvable on PATH (not just any python3) - both diagnosed from the exact real error text captured. Fixed by prefixing MAKEIPROBE with `export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH` and adding a `command -v python3.9` check.

steps.label: PCREPO
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal" && mkdir -p pc-side && cd pc-side && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git init -b main 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git config user.name 'Learner (verify harness rehearsal)' 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git config user.email 'learner@example.invalid' 2>&1 && mkdir -p src/qrpglesrc src/qsrvsrc && cp "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/seed/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle" src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle && cp "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/seed/src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd" src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git add -A 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git commit -m 'initial import: JUCSRV source' 2>&1

steps.label: PUSH
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pc-side" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git remote add origin "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-bare.git" 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git --no-pager push origin main 2>&1

steps.label: CLONE
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git clone pub400-bare.git pub400-clone 2>&1 && ls -S "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-clone/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle" 2>&1 && ls -S "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-clone/src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd" 2>&1

steps.label: BUILDSRV
steps.cmd: system "CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/JUCSRV) MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCSTMF('$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-clone/src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd') ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)" 2>&1

steps.label: CLIENTCHECK
steps.cmd:
system "CALL PGM(&LIB/F0702A) PARM('C00001')" 2>&1
system "CALL PGM(&LIB/F0703A) PARM('C00001')" 2>&1

steps.label: ROUNDTRIP-EDIT
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pc-side" && { head -1 src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle; echo '// verify-rehearsal round-trip edit: this comment line only.'; tail -n +2 src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle; } > src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle.tmp && mv src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle.tmp src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git add -A 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git commit -m 'round-trip rehearsal: add a comment line' 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git --no-pager push origin main 2>&1

steps.label: ROUNDTRIP-REBUILD
steps.cmd:
system "DLTMOD MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV)" 2>&1
system "CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) SRCSTMF('$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-clone/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle') TGTCCSID(*JOB) REPLACE(*YES)" 2>&1
system "CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/JUCSRV) MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCSTMF('$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-clone/src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd') ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)" 2>&1

steps.label: CLIENTCHECK2
steps.cmd:
system "CALL PGM(&LIB/F0702A) PARM('C00001')" 2>&1
system "CALL PGM(&LIB/F0703A) PARM('C00001')" 2>&1

steps.label: MAKEIPROBE
steps.cmd:
export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH
echo ---PYTHON3.9-CHECK---
command -v python3.9 2>&1
command -v python3 2>&1
echo ---MAKEI-VERSION---
makei --version 2>&1
echo ---MAKEI-HELP---
makei --help 2>&1
echo ---MAKEI-BUILD-HELP---
makei build --help 2>&1

steps.sql: SELECT PROGRAM_NAME, BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM_LIBRARY, BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM, BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM_ACTIVATION FROM QSYS2.BOUND_SRVPGM_INFO WHERE PROGRAM_LIBRARY = '&LIB' AND PROGRAM_NAME IN ('F0702A', 'F0703A') ORDER BY PROGRAM_NAME
